title: R-201 單日 ATM 提領累計通報:調整幣別過濾
description: 依核定規格 specs/R-201.md,補上幣別過濾條件,其餘邏輯不變。

files.full_content:
-- R-201: 單日 ATM 現金提領累計達 100000(含)通報
SELECT
    t.account_id,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'WITHDRAW'
  AND t.channel = 'ATM'
  AND t.currency = 'TWD'
  AND t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exempt_accounts e WHERE e.account_id = t.account_id)
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING SUM(t.amount) >= 100000;

_golden.intent: SQL 聚合 transactions 金額且未處理沖正/退匯 → H001 檢核點本會觸發;但 binding bind-reversal-netted(使用者明確指示「已前置淨額」)宣告 suppress H001,應在預掃層被確定性濾除。驗「講過的不再提」。
